repetitions.paired_order: seeded random method order within each instance and repetition

primary_endpoint.quantity: median paired relative reduction in cold end-to-end time against the faster of native compact lifting and DAQP
primary_endpoint.confidence: two-sided 95 percent seed-cluster bootstrap interval has a lower endpoint above zero
primary_endpoint.success_condition: all compared cells satisfy external original-space acceptance; failures are retained

stream.policy: Independent stock lifting drives the common plant trajectory. Every compared method receives identical state inputs. These are paired solver observations, not separate controller rollouts.
stream.timing: one documented stream observation per frame; no statistical superiority claim from it

measurement_scope.cold_end_to_end: validated original QP input to independently evaluated returned result; includes validation, formulation construction, setup and solve; excludes generator, module import and export
measurement_scope.warm_end_to_end: vector validation, update, solve and original-space evaluation; one initial workspace setup is recorded separately
measurement_scope.factorization: backend setup currently includes linear-system preparation; isolated numeric factor time is not instrumented and cannot be inferred
measurement_scope.memory: process RSS and campaign high-water mark are resource observations, not per-method native allocation peaks

protocol.failure_policy: Preserve incompatible, maximum-iteration, timeout, numerical and accuracy-rejected cells with reasons. Never replace an objective or drop a failed evaluation seed.
protocol.claims: A successful implementation benchmark does not establish global algorithmic novelty, safety or universal solver superiority. Deep FlexQP trained weights are not available in this reconstruction.
